meta_description: McGill-Mills Decor is a trusted painter and decorator in Nottingham. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, professional finish guaranteed.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior decorating. Free quote, no pressure, quality finish every time.
services_subhead: From single-room refreshes to full house renovations, interior feature walls to exterior cladding, we handle every job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls in any colour and finish. We prepare surfaces properly, choose the right paint for each room, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Refresh fascias, soffits, doors, and external walls. Weather-resistant finishes protect your property and boost kerb appeal for years to come.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert pattern-matching and precision hanging on feature walls, full rooms, or whole properties. We remove old wallpaper and prepare walls to perfection.

services.title: Woodwork & Door Finishing
services.desc: Interior and exterior doors, skirting boards, and built-in furniture painted to a flawless finish. Colour-matched and durably sealed.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Effects
services.desc: Textured finishes, faux effects, and bespoke paint treatments tailored to your vision. Transform tired rooms into statement spaces.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, retail units, and business premises refreshed on schedule and within budget. We work flexibly around your operating hours.

about_pullquote: Attention to detail is everything. Your home deserves a decorator who gets it right.
about_para_1: McGill-Mills Decor has been transforming Nottingham homes and businesses for over 15 years. We started with a simple belief: that great decorating should be reliable, fairly priced, and delivered on time. From small single-room updates to complete house renovations, we've built our reputation on showing up when we say we will, respecting your space, and leaving you delighted with the result.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, we don't over-promise, and we care about the finish. We carry our own materials, work efficiently, and treat every job—whether a kitchen refresh or a whole-house redecoration—with the same professionalism and pride. That's why so many Nottingham families ask for us by name.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the lounge and hallway done. Dave and the lads were brilliant—tidy, professional, and didn't rush the job. Finished on time, walls look immaculate. Proper job. Will be calling them back for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: They came out for a free quote, explained what the room needed, and didn't try to upsell me. Stuck to the price, finished early, and the paint finish is flawless. Really impressed. Top marks.
reviews.author: Catherine W.

reviews.text: External rendering and woodwork looked shabby. McGill-Mills sorted it all—priced fairly, worked around the weather, and the house looks like new. Can't fault them. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Paul M.
